text:
deploy-bot: 🟢 kicking off config-only rollout cfg-2026-03-qofloor-01 -> staging then canary. Changes: per-tenant min_qps=5, route_weight_floor=0.02 (weighted-steering), default_timeout_ms: 800->700, batch_max_tokens: 2048->1536 (soft), kv_cache_prefetch=enabled. Canary plan: 3% -> 15% -> 50% over 30m steps. Change window: immediate (staging->canary). Rollback playbook linked in checklist below.

nina: quick question — why lower timeout to 700ms? small models may blow p99 during warmups. any fallback? :eyes: 

sam: lowering timeout lets more requests fall fast and free up capacity; combined with route_floor we expect fewer long tails. mitigation = keep kv_cache_prefetch and small slow-start batch ramp. If p99 > 1200ms OR kv_miss_rate >= baseline*2 we abort.

priya: I will add the alerts now (p99 by tenant, kv_miss_rate, cpu/gpu stall count). dashboard: https://obs.redwood/dashboards/qofloor-canary (shared).

jake: command ready. will kick when ops gives thumbs and deploy-bot is clear. Suggested dry-run: /deploy config-only cfg-2026-03-qofloor-01 --canary 3% --steps 15,50 --interval 1800s --tags stable

deploy-bot: ✅ canary 3% started. Applied routing weight override to 3% of traffic for tagged routes (stable). Monitoring window begins. Checkpoints: +30m, +60m.

ops-bot: metrics snapshot (baseline vs now): p50 58ms -> 60ms, p95 190ms -> 210ms, p99 440ms -> 480ms, kv_miss_rate 0.6% -> 0.7%. No throttles so far.

nina: nice. keep an eye on multi-tenant hotspots — eta-corp has higher qps distribution, could surface first.

sam: noted. adding tenant-scoped alert for eta-corp p99>1000ms.

(30m checkpoint) ops-bot: checkpoint results: p99 global 490ms, eta-corp p99 1500ms, kv_miss_rate for eta-corp 1.8% (baseline 0.6%).

sam: HOLD — eta-corp spike looks correlated with our route_weight_floor; their KV cache pressure increased. Recommend pause ramp and evaluate revert of route_weight_floor for that tenant.

priya: pausing ramp. I'll mute next step and turn on tenant pin for eta-corp to previous routing set (route tag override).

jake: executing tenant pin now: /deploy config-pin --tenant eta-corp --to cfg-prev-2026-02-18 --reason "kv_pressure spike" 

deploy-bot: ✅ pin applied for tenant eta-corp -> cfg-prev-2026-02-18. Canary remains at 3% for others; ramp steps paused.

ops-bot: post-pin metrics (5m after): eta-corp p99 down to 520ms, kv_miss_rate 0.7%. global p99 480ms.

nina: good signal. next steps: 1) run a focused kv warmup for eta-corp keys (prefetch script), 2) re-evaluate batch_max_tokens reduction (maybe soften to 1792), 3) keep staged ramp but require per-tenant check gates.

sam: agree. action items: Priya add per-tenant gating to the rollout rules, Jake prepare warmup script + runbook, I'll draft rollback snippet. Rollback command if we need full revert: /deploy rollback cfg-2026-03-qofloor-01 --to=cfg-prev-2026-02-18 --scope=global

priya: drafting release note blurb for release notes: "Config-only: QoS tether and routing floor to reduce long-tail cost. Includes per-tenant min_qps, reduced default timeout, and batch max_tokens tweak. Canary staged with per-tenant gating; eta-corp temporarily pinned due to KV pressure. Monitoring and rollback playbook enabled."

jake: warmup script ran for eta-corp keys (synthetic warmup) — ops-bot shows kv_miss_rate trending back to baseline. ready to try soft ramp to 15% with per-tenant gates.

sam: proceed to 15% for non-pinned tenants only. keep 30m watch and immediate rollback criteria: global p99 > 1200ms OR any tenant kv_miss_rate >= baseline*2 OR error rate > 0.5% absolute increase.

deploy-bot: ✅ ramp to 15% started (excluding pinned tenants). Next checkpoint +30m.

ops-bot: live snapshot: global p99 510ms, eta-corp pinned p99 520ms, kv_miss overall 0.75%. No elevated errors.

nina: :thumbsup: sounds safe. schedule final 50% ramp during change window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 PT if all checks green.

priya: I'll update release notes and the changelog entry, tag the config as "canary-paused-pin-handled" for audit.

sam: closing notes: learned that route_weight_floor interacts poorly with cold-kv heavy tenants; add a note to model onboarding docs. If anything degrades during next steps we revert to cfg-prev-2026-02-18 and file a follow-up.

jake: thanks team — will wait for the scheduled window for the final ramp.

deploy-bot: 🟡 thread closed for now (canary paused->resumed path logged). If rollback happens, this thread will be updated.
